Welcome to Amar Chiropractic Bonesetter, led by Amar Bahadur Kewat in Andheri, Mumbai. We specialise in chiropractic bone adjustment, spine and joint pain treatment, and holistic healing therapies. Our services help patients suffering from slip disc, disc bulge, scoliosis, pinched nerve pain, sinus issues, numbness, tingling, tailbone pain, hip pain, ankle pain, heel pain, wrist pain, leg pain, elbow pain, head pain, sprains, vertigo, knee pain, neck pain, lumbar spondylosis, sciatica, frozen shoulder, cervical spondylosis, paralysis, sports injuries, migraines, headaches, chronic pain, and muscle strain injuries. 

We provide safe, non-surgical bone setting, chiropractic treatment, body alignment, and relief from muscle pain. Alongside chiropractic care, we also offer osteopathy, acupuncture, acupressure, massage therapy, reflexology, sujok, magnet therapy, naturopathy, panchakarma, Ayurveda, and cupping therapy.

Call & WhatsApp: +91 7700021141.
